name: Hierarchy without colour alone
rule: Show importance through size, weight, position and shape or icons. The design should still read clearly in greyscale.

leaders.note: Says colour must not be the only signal. Add placement, order, shape, icons or labels, and test the app in greyscale to find places where colour alone carries meaning.
Says colour must not be the only way to share information, signal actions, ask for a response or tell elements apart. Suggests checking designs with a colour-blind simulator.
